about.subtitle: WHO WE ARE
about.title: About Our Consultancy
about.cardBody: Public Health Consulting Services is a professional public health consultancy providing expert guidance in public health, preventive care, healthcare management, medical education, and wellness solutions. We partner with organizations, institutions, and communities to strengthen health systems and improve population health outcomes.
about.missionText: To improve community health through quality consultation, education, and evidence-based healthcare solutions that empower organizations and professionals to deliver impactful public health programs.
about.visionText: To become a trusted leader in healthcare consultancy and public health development, recognized for excellence in training, research, and capacity building across Pakistan and beyond.
about.feature1Body: Our multidisciplinary team brings decades of combined experience in public health, medicine, research, and healthcare management.
about.feature2Body: We apply rigorous epidemiological methods and health information systems to design interventions grounded in evidence.
about.feature3Body: Every engagement is tailored to your organizational context, priorities, and the communities you serve.

expertise.subtitle: OUR TEAM
expertise.title: Professional Expertise & Technical Capacity
expertise.intro: Our team comprises multidisciplinary public health professionals with national and international experience in research, training, program management, and health systems strengthening.
expertise.bannerBody: Extensive work with UNICEF, WHO, UNFPA, IOM, and leading national institutions across Pakistan.
expertise.quote: We combine academic excellence with practical field experience to deliver solutions that are both scientifically rigorous and operationally feasible.

training.subtitle: EXPERTISE & EXPERIENCE
training.title: Training Module & Manual Development
training.intro: With extensive experience in developing evidence-based training materials aligned with national and international standards, we create comprehensive modules and manuals for health professionals.
training.featured: we have developed 9 training modules for KP-HCIP, project of world bank
training.methodology: Our methodologies integrate evidence-based practice, international guidelines, adult learning principles, and competency-based training approaches.
training.areasSubtitle: KEY AREAS OF MODULE & MANUAL DEVELOPMENT
training.impactBody: Our training materials have strengthened technical competencies, improved service delivery standards, and supported evidence-based decision-making across health programs.
training.coreNote: Aligned with national priorities and global public health standards
